selected_top_5.reasoning: The main loop is centered on enduring as long as possible while managing health, movement, enemies, and a survival timer that directly ends the run.
Zombie or raider enemies are core antagonists, the UI and text frame the run as holding out against hostile undead-style pressure, and death can occur from being overrun.
Wood and stone are harvested from world nodes and then spent on structures, making resource collection and expenditure a meaningful supporting system.
Players can place barricades and beacon structures, but construction is lightweight and secondary rather than a deep settlement-building loop.

This is not actually a shooter, but from the provided category universe it is one of the closest action-combat labels because the game is a character-based overhead combat experience with hostile AI and role classes.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not contain an exact match for top-down melee survival action with harvesting and building, so the fifth slot is approximate.
The game includes role selection and spectator flight, but those are not dominant enough to outrank the survival and gathering systems.
Construction exists, yet it is light enough that 'Base building game' is a partial rather than perfect fit.
